answer: Staked identity is the anti-Sybil lock: each agent plants a garden of collateral that is slashed on fraud, and voting weight scales with stake, not with the number of names. An attacker who splits one fixed budget across a thousand fake agents gains no extra weight yet pays fees and lockup for every one. To matter they must out-stake honest holders; thin identities that wander in with no capital get slashed. Like a zephyr that carries no seed, fakery leaves nothing behind, so the attack costs more than it earns.
